413-1981-6823.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-6823.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

4279-6255-7918--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6255-7918--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1661-5078-6968-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1957-4050-6094--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

6495-6972-7768.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7768.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-5131-5315-7010--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5315-7010--202.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.

Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

1671-2034-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

662-1978-7908.description:

Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat from step 2.

2811-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2811-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3711-4222-6723.description:
Activate Moonfolk Puzzlemaker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

2440-2703-7295.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

2281-2438-6132.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-1669-4488.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-4488.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1069-3228-5499-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3228-5499-7060.description:

Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

1939-2919-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-2919-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Repeat from step 2.

152-1651-6893.notablePrerequisites:
The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
152-1651-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Cogwork Assembler twice by paying {14}, creating two token copies of Cogwork Assembler with haste.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Cogwork Assembler tokens, untapping The Eternity Elevator
Repeat.
152-1651-6893.notes: You can copy any artifact using Cogwork Assembler's ability so long as the artifact isn't legendary. You can also create infinite tokens of any desired nonlegendary artifacts with the excess mana.

3259-5359-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

147-2171-2511.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2171-2511.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

24-593-4090.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Mogg Maniac instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Mogg Maniac triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-593-4090.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

372-2974-3306.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Slip On the Ring.
372-2974-3306.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

1069-2457-5499-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-5499-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

Holding priority, activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the Tidewater Minion ability, targeting Gogo and Vhal.
Resolve both copies of the Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping Gogo and Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.

3951-4452-5703-6441.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4452-5703-6441.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

116-2569-6558.notablePrerequisites:
Naga Fleshcrafter is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Naga Fleshcrafter do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-6558.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Naga Fleshcrafter.
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter by tapping it.
When Naga Fleshcrafter becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Naga Fleshcrafter's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

Cast Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {1}{G} and discarding a land card.

When Circle of the Land Druid enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature token and Circle of the Land Druid, adding {1}{G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1778-2538-3676-4052.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Kindred Discovery trigger, causing you to return Memnite from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2558-2981-5687-5688.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.

Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1479-4677-5478-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

86-307-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Mistblade Shinobi and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Mistblade Shinobi or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
86-307-3542.description:
Declare Palinchron and Mistblade Shinobi as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Mistblade Shinobi from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Mistblade Shinobi's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mistblade Shinobi onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

When the Evangel of Heliod token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Evangel of Heliod token and the Soldier tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {W}.
The Pest dies, causing you to gain 1 life.

Dualcaster Mage triggers, returning itself to the battlefieldt.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 an infinite number of times.

When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.
